entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Innistrad's darkest province of jagged peaks, perpetual dusk and ancient vampire rule.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane containing Stensia.

entities.name: Geier Reach
entities.description: The defining mountain range of Stensia, with few passes.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose return gave Stensians hope before her madness and unmaking.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel who with her Host of Herons drove out vampires, then withdrew to Gavony.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire whose stronghold is the Lurenbraum Fortress.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker whose magic tore Markov Manor from its perch.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Ruined vampire estate left floating above Stensia by Nahiri's magic.

entities.name: Lurenbraum Fortress
entities.description: Mist-shrouded citadel guarding Ziel Pass; Olivia Voldaren's stronghold.

entities.name: Captain Cosper Lowe
entities.description: Leader of the Silbern Guard.

entities.name: Mayor Deigenhard
entities.description: Leader of Wollebank who seeks to unite valley communities after losing his son to vampires.

entities.name: Strefan Maurer
entities.description: Progenitor of a minor vampiric bloodline who attacked Heron's Light Hold.

entities.name: Thatu Reiniger
entities.description: Vampire lord who wielded the Bloodletter at Maalfeld.

entities.name: Anje Falkenrath
entities.description: Reclaimed the Heron's Grace Monastery.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker whose presence inspired tales of a mad wizard on Mount Baratok.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: Owner of Vess Manor.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: Hunted Eldrazi-corrupted angels from his tower during the Travails.

entities.name: Host of Herons
entities.description: Sigarda's angelic host.

entities.name: Keepers of the Feather
entities.description: A local coven of witches.

entities.name: Travails
entities.description: Period when Eldrazi corruption afflicted Innistrad.

entities.name: Wollebank
entities.description: Largest and best-fortified village in Stensia.

entities.name: Silbern Guard
entities.description: Cathar watch protecting the Silbern valley.

events.summary: With Avacyn's return, Sigarda and her Host of Herons strive to drive out Stensia's vampires, leaving castles in ruin.
events.quote: The angel Sigarda and her Host of Herons strove to drive out the vampires, leaving many castles in ruin.

events.summary: After Avacyn's madness and unmaking, Sigarda withdraws to Gavony and the vampires reclaim their fortresses.
events.quote: Immune to the angels' madness, Sigarda and her host withdrew to Gavony , and the vampires reclaimed their fortresses

events.summary: Nahiri's magic tears Markov Manor from its mountain perch.
events.quote: torn from its mountain perch and left floating above Stensia by Nahiri 's magic.

events.summary: Strefan Maurer attacks Heron's Light Hold, killing the knights and forcing Sigarda to flee.
events.quote: The hold was attacked by Strefan Maurer , and the knights were all killed, forcing Sigarda to flee.

events.summary: Anje Falkenrath reclaims the Heron's Grace Monastery built by Sigarda.
events.quote: until it was reclaimed by Anje Falkenrath .

relations.quote: Stensia is the shadowed heart of Innistrad
serving as the stronghold of Olivia Voldaren and her vast estate.
The Silbern Guard is led by Captain Cosper Lowe
